title: [3.0beta11] Dash temporary basal rates precision: calculating plus of every 0,01 instead of 0,05
symptom: When an over 100% temporary basal rate is running on the Dash pump, the sum of the 'plus' insulin is being counted with a precision of 0.01 instead of 0.05, and the IOB counter increments in 0.01 steps, although the Omnipod has a precision of 0.05.
cause: The thread does not establish a root cause; the maintainers state it is not a real bug because IOB can have lower resolution than the minimum pod delivery step.
fix: No fix is provided; the issue is dismissed as not a real bug.
evidence_quote: I don't think this is a real bug. IOB can have lower resolution than the minimum pod delivery step.
